description: Pins the one-shot overlay migration of #31 (scripts/migrate-overlays.ts). `records`: for each record translated before the migration, three hashes: its English record, the overlay entries localize() reads for it after the migration, and its display text under the old merge ({ ...en, ...overlay }). `changes`: every display text that differs between the old merge and localize(), all of them reference labels, plus the target names the labels were relocated to.
